//: Copy to zecor.config.json (gitignored) or .zecor/config.json. Every field is
//1: optional; the values below are the defaults. Environment variables override
//2: the file: ZECOR_MODE, ZECOR_LM_BASE_URL, ZECOR_ROOT, etc.

local_model.//base_url: OpenAI-compatible endpoint: LM Studio, Ollama (/v1), vLLM, llama.cpp

cloud_fallback.//: Credentials come from the environment, never this file.
cloud_fallback.//keys: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY in the shell that starts zecor;
cloud_fallback.//keys2: run_capped strips them from every lane subprocess.

deterministic_tools.//: Absolute paths only if the binary is not on PATH.

gate.//script: The per-repo deterministic gate. .fleet/verify.sh is still accepted.

autonomy.//spend: 0 disables the USD ceiling; the vendor quota table still throttles.
